# Stuart Hampshire

*1914 – 2004 · British · [Analytic Philosophy](../movements/analytic-philosophy.md)*

Oxford philosopher: in *Thought and Action* (1959), he describes the person first and foremost as an agent moving among objects and choosing, with thought ordered to action.
